top_choice_rationale: Aberration correction in TEM removed a barrier long held to be fundamental (Scherzer's theorem) through original invention by Rose, Haider and Urban, was verified independently within a few years, is now mature, and yields new measured quantities such as atom-column positions and local bonding. The three names are the documented originators of the TEM corrector. The optical lattice clock (P001) is also a genuine original invention and is a close second, but I rank the corrector first on the original-invention test; I acknowledge the uncredited STEM corrector work as a real attribution weakness. No award is clearly the weakest option.
recusal_note: Possible conflict: I am a practising transmission electron microscopist at Chalmers and my own field benefits from aberration correction; no personal collaboration with Rose, Urban or Haider is apparent from my profile.
